page_title: Plonk — a toolbox for your Mac

summary.name: Plonk
summary.one_liner: Plonk is a free, open-source (MIT) macOS menu bar toolbox of eight native utilities for window zones and workspaces, screenshots, on-device OCR, screen measuring, keep-awake, pointer tools, shortcut guides, and voice/agent control.
use_cases: copy text from videos or locked PDFs
keep Mac awake during a build
give AI agents control of Mac capture and window tools
summary.what_it_does: Plonk bundles eight utilities behind one menu bar icon, sharing a command palette, shortcuts and a local automation surface. The window module lets you draw custom zones per monitor and save workspaces that reopen apps, frames, files and URLs on the correct displays. Screenshot tools capture regions at native resolution with markup, and a live pinned crop stays above other windows without being saved to disk. On-device OCR copies text from images, videos and interfaces, and a screen ruler reports distances in points and pixels. Pulse keeps the Mac awake by timer, schedule, app, charging state or process lifetime, and a shortcut guide reads the front app's menus. Twenty-two MCP tools let agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor use the app.
notable: Twenty-two MCP tools for AI agents, connectable over stdio or HTTP
On-device OCR and no cloud, account or telemetry; single loopback listener with token-gated API
Signed and attested GitHub releases, verifiable with gh attestation verify
Display UUIDs keep workspaces stable when monitors are unplugged
caveats: Requires macOS 13 or newer on Apple silicon
Needs Accessibility and Screen Recording grants for some features
Early version 0.4.x by a single author; MCP tool names and HTTP API may change between minor versions
Signed but not notarized, so macOS requires a manual download approval unless installed via the Homebrew cask
